label: Duplicate contribution guidance
initiation: Proposed guidance addresses duplicated discussion and assistance with Git workflows.
outcome: The merged text retains the same-change qualifier and the optional assistance route.
alternative_explanation: A general contribution barrier is an overreading; the help option may reduce barriers.
level_rationale: Guidance is amended; the embedded instruction governs contribution practice.

span.quote: Please refrain from creating several pull requests for the same change.

If you have problems with squashing (or other workflows with `git`), you can
alternatively enable "Allow edits from maintainers" in the right GitHub
sidebar and ask for help in the pull request.
Well, not in general, but we want to encourage it for people that don't know how to use git.
